subject: AWS CPPO enablement sprint and reseller evidence walkthrough
messages:
From: Hannah Cole <hannah.cole@resellco.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CPPO kickoff + operational questions

Hi Logan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. ResellCo is keen to move forward with a Channel Private Offer (CPPO) for the ACME account. Before we lock timelines, the ops team needs a short checklist and a quick walkthrough so we can align on entitlements, invoice routing, and evidence required for marketplace approval.

Primary asks:
- A one-page ops checklist (who does what and timelines).
- SKU <-> entitlement mapping for the Redwood SKUs we'll list.
- SOC2 / pen test evidence and expected delivery cadence for our procurement team.
- How DocuSign PO + marketplace invoice split is handled (we have a fiscal entity mapping question).

Can we schedule a 30-minute walkthrough early next week? I attached our onboarding questions and the signed NDA for your records.

Attachments: resellco_onboarding_questions.xlsx (spreadsheet), nda_signed.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Hannah Cole
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
ResellCo Cloud Partners
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Cole <hannah.cole@resellco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO kickoff + operational questions

Hi Hannah —

Appreciate the clear list. I'm available Monday or Tuesday morning PT for a 30-minute walkthrough. I attached a working draft: CPPO-ops-checklist-v1.xlsx which lays out recommended owners, a timeline (pre-activation / go-live / post-live), and the typical evidence bundle we provide for marketplace validation.

Quick notes before the call:
- Entitlement mapping: Ben will own SKU <-> customer entitlement mapping and confirm whether the ACME SKUs need to be split across two payor entities.
- Evidence: We can provide SOC2 Type II summary + a scoped pen-test Q&A. Full reports require an NDA/entitlement request; we typically surface redacted artifacts via secure share.
- Billing / invoice split: Vanessa will outline the DocuSign > CPPO mapping and options for invoice routing depending on entity mapping.

Proposed times (PT):
- Mon 10/31 09:30 - 10:00
- Tue 11/01 08:30 - 09:00

If neither works, tell me what time block fits your procurement lead and we'll take it.

Attachment: CPPO-ops-checklist-v1.xlsx

—
Logan Wright
Head of Channel GTM, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Hannah Cole <hannah.cole@resellco.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -0700

Thanks — adding a quick SKU note.

On Thu, Oct 29, 2026 at 10:03 AM Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Appreciate the clear list. I'm available Monday or Tuesday morning PT for a 30-minute walkthrough. I attached a working draft: CPPO-ops-checklist-v1.xlsx...

Hannah — for the ACME mapping we currently have two candidate SKUs that map to the same feature set; the preference for CPPO is to list the consolidated SKU to avoid entitlement divergence. If ACME requires per-entity invoicing, we can create split entitlements but that triggers two subscriber ids in the marketplace and will require reconciliation guidance.

Action items for the call:
- Confirm whether ACME wants a single consolidated SKU (simpler) or split per legal entity (billing complexity).
- If split, we'll need a PO per entity and to coordinate invoice co-routing.

I can pull historical examples of invoice splits from other resellers for the call.

—Ben
Senior Partner Ops
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Cole <hannah.cole@resellco.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO kickoff + operational questions

Hi all —

Booked a 30-minute slot for Tue 11/01 08:30 - 09:00 PT. Calendar invite sent to Hannah and Amit.

For the DocuSign / PO flow:
- We typically require a single DocuSign PO per CPPO activation. If the reseller needs multiple payors, we either: 1) process separate PO documents per payor and attach them to one CPPO record in the marketplace UI, or 2) accept a single inter-entity billing instruction and route invoices to each payor via our finance team. Option 1 is faster for marketplace activation; option 2 requires AP reconciliation on both sides.

Drive folder with evidence templates and the checklist: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cCPPO-ResellCo
DocuSign template (for reference): https://www.docusign.com/en/agreements/ABC-1234-CPPO

I'll prepare a short script for the call showing the DocuSign -> marketplace UI mapping and bring examples for invoice routing. Kimberly, please prepare high-level notes on tax jurisdiction / VAT edgecases for the call.

—Vanessa
Partner Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Amit Shah <amit.shah@resellco.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO kickoff + operational questions

Thanks everyone — Tue 08:30 PT works for us. We prefer option 1 (separate PO per legal entity) to keep our internal billing clean. I've attached the preliminary PO for ACME entity 1 and we'll follow up with entity 2 by EOD Monday.

A few follow-ups for the walkthrough:
- Please confirm how the marketplace will display the subscriber if there are two POs tied to one CPPO.
- We will need a redacted SOC2 summary and the pen-test Q&A during the call to satisfy our procurement pre-checks.

Attachments: ResellCo_PO_8743.pdf

Looking forward to the walkthrough.

Best,
Amit Shah
Head of Partnerships, ResellCo Cloud Partners
